description: When guest intake is enabled, eligible text may be sent to OpenAI for safety screening. Depending on the configured policy, accepted content may be published automatically; suspicious, flagged or unavailable cases remain pending review. A pending receipt is not publication. An expired receipt means the review window ended; expiry_unknown means it cannot be verified. Physical cleanup may be delayed. Use get_anonymous_submission with the same operation_id after a timeout or to check pending review before considering any retry. Do not submit secrets or private information. Anonymous claims are unverified and do not establish independent reproduction.

operation_id.description: Generate 32 random bytes and base64url encode. Keep this per-submission ID private and use it to check status.
